30797:

30801:

30802:

Field at the centre adds 4 equal sides, B = 4 \times \frac{\mu_0 i}{4 \pi d} (\sin 45^\circ + \sin 45^\circ) with apothem d = \frac{1}{2 \sqrt{2}} \text{ m}.
Each side gives \frac{10^{-7} \times 5}{1 / (2 \sqrt{2})} \times \sqrt{2} = 2 \times 10^{-6} \text{ T}.
Four sides give B = 8 \times 10^{-6} \text{ T}, so p = 8 → (8)

At constant pressure heat feeds enthalpy, E_1 = C_p \Delta T, while internal energy takes E_2 = C_v \Delta T.
Their ratio is \frac{E_1}{E_2} = \gamma = \frac{5}{3} for a monoatomic gas.
Setting \frac{5}{3} = \frac{x}{9} gives x = 15 → (15)
